releaseNotes: Expands the offline biblical dictionary from 86 to 100 contextual entries, adding apostasy, canon of Scripture, Christology, crucifixion, diaspora, epistles, fasting, Immanuel, Jubilee, martyrdom, New Jerusalem, divine omnipotence, Christ's parousia and sanctuary. Every new entry includes Scripture references and interpretive cautions, validated against the bundled KJV. Retains 85 word studies, 122 commentary notes, 30 worship pathways and 139 faith-response references. Refreshes the offline cache.
